comment: Outcome assertions for conformance/cinematography.json — the ext-cinematography extension's conformance is math, not pixels: fold the world, derive, check predicates. Any implementation may run the same checks (js/src/cinematography.js runOutcomes does, in CI). Assertion kinds: fov {camera, hfov_degrees, vfov_degrees, aspect, tolerance} (the normative crop math of spec/extensions/cinematography.md, degrees); in_frame {camera, entity} (the entity's origin projects inside the frame, NDC |x|<=1 and |y|<=1, in front of the camera); out_of_frame {camera, entity} (it doesn't); shot_list [name, ...] (the cameras carrying a shot, ordered by shot.order then entity id).
